identification: Engraving of a ruined triumphal arch, caption reads roughly 'Arc de Tite/Titus' (18th c French view of Rome, Barbault-type series, not Piranesi), heavy water staining and foxing, in a wide birdseye Huon pine (or birdseye maple) frame with gilt slip. Frame is the main value; print is minor.

viewing_check: Confirm timber: Huon pine vs birdseye maple (scent, tight small eyes, colour), frame outer size and condition of corners/joins. Photograph the caption and credit lines under the print (maker, 'Barbault' or other, date) and the mount label; check whether print is laid down and the extent of staining.
